chronology: Exploratory final signature diagnostic fixed after the historical-program primary and reference/depth outcomes. Gene-specific and single-gene-omission outcomes have not been inspected. The same eight historical genes remain fixed; no replacement or success-count threshold will be chosen after outcomes.
question: Is the observed historical-program score response dependent on one transcript, and which of its eight transcripts show increased marginal RNA distributions? This does not measure same-cell coactivation or regulatory mechanism.
source: Use archived k562_context direct_fit and original normalized unique counts. Preserve all discovery-control parameters and inference IDs. Require exact reconstruction of every original direct program record before new inference.
tests: For each of all105 single perturbations, test all8 individual transcript scores and all8 leave-one-gene-out scores, always removing exactly one of the fixed eligible markers. Individual transcripts use their normalized log counts; omission scores average the remaining seven fixed discovery-standardized values. Existing gemgroup-stratified one-sided Mann-Whitney, min20 cells and AUC>=.55. No new gene selection, scaling fit or favorable subset.
family: The original8400 complete eight-arm hypotheses plus all8*105=840 individual-transcript and840 omission hypotheses enter one BH family of10080. Preserve original context flags, and name the new correction fields separately. Report negative and unscored outcomes. No new identity test is needed because these diagnostics concern effect directions and omission stability.
summary: For every105 label retain the number of individual transcripts meeting the fixed criterion, all eight individual AUCs, all eight omission AUCs and whether all eight omission comparisons pass. Report CBL,UBASH3B,PTPN12,KLF1 as preidentified cases. Do not invent a success threshold for the number of transcript increases. Intersection with earlier robustness remains descriptive and does not provide a new FDR guarantee.
limits: The signature was historically selected on the same data. Nominal p/q values and these correction families do not account for that historical selection process. Shared cells, correlated genes and technical strata are not independent biological replications. Marginal multi-gene changes do not prove simultaneous within-cell coactivation, a causal regulon, pathway specificity or novelty. No SAE superiority follows.
outputs: Complete1680 new comparisons, original8400 with new correction fields, all105 summaries, preserved parameters, exact parent/input/source hashes, software versions and fresh exclusive output paths. No new training or data.
